note: 桁 is a standard structural beam or girder term and fits the main-support sense in this building definition.
下水道 is a sewer system, and cống is the ordinary Vietnamese word for a sewer or drainage pipe; the waste context supplies the intended sense.
kí túc xá usually means student housing. Nhà ở tập thể is a natural descriptive term for shared communal accommodation that also fits soldiers or monks.
sự khâu suggests stitching by hand. Việc may is a natural general Vietnamese phrase for the act of sewing.
姪 is the direct Japanese word for niece, and cháu gái is the standard Vietnamese kinship term; the stated sibling relation disambiguates it from granddaughter.
詫び is a valid Japanese noun for apology. Lời xin lỗi is more natural Vietnamese for an expression of remorse.
殻 suggests a hard shell or pod. 皮 has a JMdict husk sense and better covers the dry leafy or stringy exterior; verified in ent_seq 1483800 sense 1.
さらう also means carry off or snatch. 誘拐 is the specific term for abduction or kidnapping and is a suru-verb; verified in JMdict ent_seq 1541930 sense 0.
住居 is a suitable formal word for dwelling. Correct the Vietnamese spelling from chổ ở to chỗ ở.
振動 and rung động both name physical vibration; the emotional use of rung động is disambiguated by this definition.
ビニール is the standard Japanese word for vinyl or flexible plastic material in this physical sense.
洗剤 is the ordinary Japanese equivalent for a non-soap cleaning agent; soap itself is normally 石鹸.
giận means anger generally and does not express feeling wronged. Oán giận is resentment or anger arising from a perceived wrong.
爪 covers nails and claws generally. 鉤爪 means a hooked claw or talon; verified in JMdict ent_seq 2144540 sense 0.
ホームページ often means an entire website or its home page. ウェブページ means a single web page; verified in JMdict ent_seq 2159270 sense 0.
行列 has a standard procession or parade sense and fits an orderly group moving together; other senses such as queue are separate contexts.
コンセント and ổ cắm điện usually mean a wall outlet. ソケット is the general Japanese socket term, verified in JMdict ent_seq 1075390 sense 0; ổ cắm is the broader Vietnamese receptacle term.
地味 is a standard equivalent for subdued, non-glaring colors and fits the stated color sense.
厚かましい is directly glossed as presumptuous and matches exceeding appropriate limits through unwarranted assumptions.
定期券 usually means a public-transit commuter pass. シーズンチケット is the event season ticket or pass; verified in JMdict ent_seq 2861762 sense 0.
họa suggests a serious calamity. Xui xẻo is the common Vietnamese expression for ordinary bad luck or misfortune.
うんこ matches the informal English poop. Vietnamese phân is more neutral, but remains a clear and suitable term for fecal matter.
雨戸 is the standard Japanese window shutter, usually a sliding panel used to block light and protect the window.
tư tưởng often suggests ideas or ideology. Lối suy nghĩ is the natural Vietnamese phrase for a mindset or way of thinking.
顎 is the standard Japanese word covering the chin or jawline, and cằm is the precise Vietnamese equivalent.
為替 has a dictionary sense of money order or draft and is valid for this prepaid payment instrument; context separates it from money exchange.
桁 and bậc độ lớn are suitable technical terms for an order of magnitude or scale.
đường một rầy is malformed and unnatural. Tàu điện một ray is the standard Vietnamese term for a monorail.
学年 has a school-year sense matching the academic year of a school; its grade-level sense is separate.
蚊帳 and màn are established terms for a mosquito net; màn is common in Northern Vietnamese, while mùng is common in the South.
学年 directly means academic year or school year for the annual period of study.
người yêu is gender-neutral. Bạn trai is the standard Vietnamese term for a male romantic partner.
マーク usually means a sign, symbol, or label rather than a measurement graduation. The English definition combines reference marks and measurement marks, which require different Japanese terms.
矢印 and mũi tên are the standard terms for an arrow symbol; the projectile sense is clearly excluded by context.
マスト and cột are suitable general terms for a tall post or mast supporting equipment; the specific application can be named when context requires it.
えび and tôm are natural general terms for this crustacean; the definition itself notes that prawn and shrimp are often confused.
rực rỡ emphasizes brilliance or vividness. Nhiều màu sắc expresses the prominent variety of colors in the stated definition.
kho covers the storage use but not housing animals. Vietnamese uses different terms for those barn functions, and I found no natural single equivalent for the combined definition.
僧 is normally a Buddhist monk, while the English definition leaves religious tradition open; tu sĩ is religion-neutral and does not specify male. No single verified pair retains both distinctions.
肥 usually means manure or fertilizer. 糞 has a JMdict sense for animal feces, excrement, or dung; verified in ent_seq 2834408 sense 0, read ふん.
